answer: An agent economy resists sybils with proof of useful external compute: each epoch, every identity must present a fresh receipt showing it donated real compute to a public science grid, like an opal mined from a shared ridge of machines. The receipt is bound to that identity's key and the epoch nonce by a ferrous, tamper-evident signature, so it cannot be copied or reused. One operator wanting a thousand fakes must donate a thousand separate compute jobs, paying full cost per fake, while an honest agent donates once.
